full_judgment:
Mohammad Gholam Rabbani J: This Appeal is by the pre-emptee against the judgment and order dated 28.4.87 of the learned Subordinate Judge, Rangpur, passed in Miscellaneous Case No. 35 of 1986 allowing a preemption under section 24 of the Non-Agricultural Tenancy Act. 

 3. It appears from the impugned judgment that the learned Subordinate Judge held the case neither bad for non-joinder of parties nor barred by limitation. All the co-sharers were made parties in the case. Sale deed under preemption was executed on 2.10.85 and was registered under section 60 of the Registration Act on 21.4.86. Preemption case was filed between the said dates on 8.3.86.
